schemaUpgrade.title: This file is in an older format
schemaUpgrade.body: The file was saved in format {fromVersion}. You can open and edit it as usual, but it will be upgraded to format {toVersion} if you save it.

schemaUpgrade.controlPlans.none: Note: in the old format control plans belong to the work area; in the new one they belong to the building element specification. This file has no control-plan links, so nothing is lost.
schemaUpgrade.controlPlans.one: Note: in the old format control plans belong to the work area; in the new one they belong to the building element specification. One link cannot be transferred unambiguously and is therefore not carried over. The control plan itself is still there - you can link it again afterwards.
schemaUpgrade.controlPlans.many: Note: in the old format control plans belong to the work area; in the new one they belong to the building element specification. {count} links cannot be transferred unambiguously and are therefore not carried over. The control plans themselves are still there - you can link them again afterwards.
